resources.string: See which apps wake the phone and keep it awake at night. Needs one more read permission on the pro page.
Nothing counted yet. Android counts on battery only; the next reading comes within half an hour.
A wakeup is an alarm that pulls the phone out of sleep; a wakelock keeps it awake with the screen off. Both drain the battery while you are not using the phone.
Counted by Android on battery only. Tap an app for its week.
In App info under Battery you can restrict its background use. Activity+ never changes this itself.
